title: A Gift That Was Too Expensive

source_links.title: Original lesson authoring registry (provenance only, not a factual source)

fact_notes: 登場人物・場面・会話はすべて架空。特定の調査・統計・外部事実を主張するものではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり、実証研究の出典ではない。

sentences.en: Rina and Ayla became friends during their first year at college.
sentences.ja: リナとアイラは大学1年のとき友達になった。

sentences.en: They often ate lunch together and shared stories about their families.
sentences.ja: 二人はよく昼食を共にし、家族について話した。

sentences.en: When Rina's birthday approached, Ayla wanted to surprise her.
sentences.ja: リナの誕生日が近づき、アイラは彼女を驚かせたいと思った。

sentences.en: She saved some money from her weekend job for several weeks.
sentences.ja: 彼女は週末の仕事で得たお金を数週間貯めた。

sentences.en: Finally, she bought a beautiful necklace at a local shop.
sentences.ja: ついに地元の店で美しいネックレスを買った。

sentences.en: However, Rina looked uncomfortable when she opened the small box.
sentences.ja: しかしリナは小さな箱を開けたとき居心地が悪そうだった。

sentences.en: The necklace was much more expensive than she had expected.
sentences.ja: ネックレスは彼女が予想していたよりずっと高価だった。

sentences.en: She thanked Ayla politely, but she soon became unusually quiet.
sentences.ja: アイラに丁寧にお礼を言ったが、まもなく普段より口数が少なくなった。

sentences.en: Ayla wondered whether she had chosen the wrong style or color.
sentences.ja: アイラはデザインか色の選択を間違えたのかと思った。

sentences.en: For a few days, both friends avoided mentioning the birthday again.
sentences.ja: 数日間、二人とも誕生日について再び触れるのを避けた。

sentences.en: Eventually, Rina decided to explain why she had felt uneasy.
sentences.ja: やがてリナはなぜ落ち着かなかったのか説明することにした。

sentences.en: She was saving money for textbooks and could not afford similar gifts.
sentences.ja: 教科書代を貯めていて、同じような贈り物を買う余裕がなかった。

sentences.en: In fact, she worried that she would disappoint Ayla later.
sentences.ja: 実は後でアイラをがっかりさせるのではないかと心配していた。

sentences.en: Ayla was surprised because she had never expected anything in return.
sentences.ja: アイラはお返しをまったく期待していなかったので驚いた。

sentences.en: The two discovered that they had attached different meanings to the gift.
sentences.ja: 二人はその贈り物に異なる意味を持たせていたと気づいた。

sentences.en: Instead of blaming each other, they discussed what made them feel comfortable.
sentences.ja: 互いを責める代わりに、何なら安心できるかを話し合った。

sentences.en: They agreed to set a modest budget for future birthday presents.
sentences.ja: 今後の誕生日プレゼントには控えめな予算を設定することに合意した。

sentences.en: They could still make personal cards or plan a special afternoon together.
sentences.ja: 心を込めたカードを作ったり、特別な午後を一緒に計画したりすることはできた。

sentences.en: Ayla offered to return the necklace, but Rina chose to keep it.
sentences.ja: アイラはネックレスを返品すると申し出たが、リナは持っておくことを選んだ。

sentences.en: This time, she accepted it freely without feeling a duty to repay Ayla.
sentences.ja: 今度はアイラにお返しをする義務を感じず、素直に受け取った。

sentences.en: Months later, Rina prepared a small picnic for Ayla's birthday.
sentences.ja: 数か月後、リナはアイラの誕生日に小さなピクニックを用意した。

sentences.en: She brought homemade sandwiches and a handwritten letter about their friendship.
sentences.ja: 手作りのサンドイッチと友情についての手書きの手紙を持ってきた。

sentences.en: Ayla enjoyed the afternoon as much as receiving an expensive present.
sentences.ja: アイラは高価な贈り物をもらうのと同じくらい、その午後を楽しんだ。

sentences.en: Their conversation had helped them understand each other's financial situations.
sentences.ja: 二人の会話は互いの経済事情を理解する助けになった。

sentences.en: They learned that thoughtful generosity respects the receiver's feelings as well as the giver's intentions.
sentences.ja: 思いやりのある気前のよさとは、贈る側の意図と同じく受け取る側の気持ちも尊重するものだと学んだ。

questions.prompt: When did Rina and Ayla become friends?
questions.explanation_ja: 大学1年のときに友達になった。

questions.prompt: How did Ayla pay for the necklace?
options: She saved money from her weekend job.
questions.explanation_ja: 週末の仕事のお金を数週間貯めた。

questions.prompt: What surprised Rina about the gift?
options: It cost much more than expected.
It was not the right color.
questions.explanation_ja: 予想よりずっと高価だった。

questions.prompt: What did both friends do for a few days?
questions.explanation_ja: 二人とも誕生日の話題を避けた。

questions.prompt: Why did Rina worry about disappointing Ayla?
options: She wanted to end their friendship.
She could not afford an equally expensive gift.
She did not like receiving cards.
questions.explanation_ja: 教科書代を貯めており同等の贈り物は難しかった。

questions.prompt: What had Ayla expected in exchange?
options: A necklace of the same price.
questions.explanation_ja: お返しはまったく期待していなかった。

questions.prompt: What does 'modest' mean in the phrase 'a modest budget'?
questions.explanation_ja: 控えめな（大きすぎない）予算という意味。
リナはネックレスを持っておくと決めた。

questions.prompt: What did Rina bring to Ayla's birthday picnic?
options: A new textbook and a cake from a shop.
Homemade sandwiches and a handwritten letter.
questions.explanation_ja: 手作りサンドイッチと手書きの手紙を持参した。

questions.prompt: What is the main message of the story?
options: Friends should always buy gifts of equal value.
Generosity includes considering how the receiver feels.
People should never accept expensive presents.
Money cannot be discussed between friends.
questions.explanation_ja: 贈る側の気持ちだけでなく受け取る側への配慮が大切。

vocabulary.definition: told or gave something to each other
cause someone to feel unexpected excitement
a piece of jewelry worn around the neck
in a way that is not normal
books used for studying a subject
almost the same in some way
felt concerned about a possible problem
as a response to something received
saying someone is responsible for a problem
feeling relaxed and free from worry
an amount of money planned for spending

vocabulary.ja: 心を込めた・個人的な

vocabulary.definition: said one was willing to do something
bring a purchased item back to the seller
something one feels required to do
made at home rather than bought
written using a pen or pencil rather than typed
showing care for other people's feelings
what a person wants or plans to do

grammar.explanation_ja: When節は行動を起こした時期を示す。

grammar.focus: much more expensive than she had expected
grammar.explanation_ja: muchは比較級を強調し、過去完了はそれ以前の予想を表す。
affordは金銭的余裕があることを表す。

grammar.focus: as well as the giver's intentions
grammar.explanation_ja: as well asは両方を尊重することを表す。

discourse.role_ja: 期待していた反応とは異なる反応を示す。
時間を置いた後の行動を導く。
落ち着かなかった具体的な理由を示す。
非難ではなく話し合いを選んだことを示す。

paraphrases.source: She was saving money for textbooks and could not afford similar gifts.
paraphrases.rewrite: She was putting money aside for course books and could not pay for gifts of a similar price.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 教材費を確保する必要があり同価格の品は買えなかった。

paraphrases.source: Ayla was surprised because she had never expected anything in return.
paraphrases.rewrite: Ayla was astonished since she had not wanted a gift in exchange.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: お返しを望んでいなかったので驚いた。

paraphrases.source: They agreed to set a modest budget for future birthday presents.
paraphrases.rewrite: They decided together to limit how much they would spend on birthday gifts.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 今後の誕生日の贈り物に支出上限を設けた。

paraphrases.source: Their conversation had helped them understand each other's financial situations.
paraphrases.rewrite: Talking about the issue allowed them to appreciate each other's money circumstances.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 話し合いにより互いの経済事情を理解できた。

cloze.explanation_ja: 値段が予想よりずっと高かった。
今後の贈り物に使える予算を決めた。
金銭に関する事情を理解した。
